messages:
maya: FYI opened a docs PR to clarify the dashboard legend (cost vs latency) and swap the old embed sample for the metricsv2 snippet — https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482
kevin: nice, can you also call out the cost bucket labels? customers keep confusing 'cost' with cumulative spend rather than per-token cost.
maya: good call. plan: add a short blurb + code example showing explicit labels. preliminary snippet: 
```yaml
widgets:
  - type: time_series
    metric: cost_per_token
    legend: ["inference_cost", "request_cost"]
    unit: "USD/token"
```
kevin: looks good. also the tracing hook example still injects trace_id via the old header name (x-old-trace). needs to be x-redwood-trace now.
omar: I can run a quick rendering check on the embed; ping me when you update links.
maya: updated the trace example and fixed two broken links (old embed path -> console/embeds). pushing a force-push with amended screenshots.
kevin: tiny nit: in the cost breakdown screenshot the legend colors are swapped compared to the sample code. either adjust the screenshot or add a note mapping colors -> labels.
maya: I'll regenerate screenshots with the correct legend colors and include an explicit color->label table under the figure.
omar: running linkcheck + markdown linter now. will report back in ~5m.
deploy-bot: running docs linkcheck job #1134...
deploy-bot: linkcheck finished: 1 warning (redirect), 0 errors.
omar: linkcheck passed but flagged a redirect from /old-embed -> /console/embeds, which you already fixed. good to merge after screenshots.
maya: uploaded new screenshots, added the color mapping table, and updated the sample snippet to show explicit units. ready for review.
kevin: reviewed & approved, looks clear to me.
docs-bot: CI: tests passed, lint OK, spellcheck flagged one acronym case (KV -> KV).
maya: fixed KV casing. merging now.
docs-bot: PR #482 merged by maya — changelog entry created.
omar: thanks everyone — that should reduce support tickets about cost confusion. :thumbsup:
